name: LIMID Knee Support | Model  YC 7201 |  Seamless Compression Knee Sleeve | Sports Knee Brace for Running, Cycling, Jumping & Gym
description:
Support your knees during sports and physical activities with the LIMID YC 7201 Knee Support. Designed with a seamless compression structure, this knee sleeve provides flexible support around the knee and surrounding lower-leg muscles while maintaining comfortable movement. Its ergonomic design follows the shape of the leg for a secure fit and consistent compression. The supportive construction is suitable for activities such as running, cycling, jumping, rowing, gym workouts, and other sports, helping provide stability and comfortable movement during exercise.
